Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Rasheed Wallace?

Rasheed Wallace is 51 years old.

Where was Rasheed Wallace born?

Rasheed Wallace was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

When was Rasheed Wallace born?

Rasheed Wallace was born on September 17, 1974.

How tall is Rasheed Wallace?

Rasheed Wallace is 6-11 (211 cm) tall.

How much did Rasheed Wallace weigh when playing?

Rasheed Wallace weighed 225 lbs (102 kg) when playing.

Is Rasheed Wallace in the Hall of Fame?

Rasheed Wallace is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Rasheed Wallace drafted?

Rasheed Wallace was drafted by Washington Bullets, 1st round (4th pick, 4th overall), 1995 NBA Draft.

What position did Rasheed Wallace play?

Power Forward, Center, and Small Forward.

When did Rasheed Wallace retire?

Rasheed Wallace last played in 2013.

What is Rasheed Wallace's net worth?

Rasheed Wallace made at least $158,110,581 playing professional basketball.

How much did Rasheed Wallace make?

Rasheed Wallace made $17,000,000 in 2004.

What did Rasheed Wallace average?

Rasheed Wallace averaged 14.4 points, 6.7 rebounds, and 1.8 assists per game.

How many rings does Rasheed Wallace have?

Rasheed Wallace won one championship.

What schools did Rasheed Wallace attend?

Rasheed Wallace attended Simon Gratz in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania and UNC.

What are Rasheed Wallace's nicknames?

Sheed, Roscoe, Dirty 30 are nicknames for Rasheed Wallace.
